title: Add Mmm to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Mmm](https://dwakatmahmoud-cmd.github.io/Mahmoud) to image
- App Description: A static web app with an Arabic (RTL) interface that fully implements Pollinations.ai’s BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE login flow on the client side without any backend servers. After logging in

Fixes #15705

gist.headline: Mmm joins the garden
gist.blurb: Mmm is now in the app directory: an Arabic, right-to-left web app that handles Pollinations sign-in entirely in the browser. No backend server hiding behind the flowerpot.
gist.summary: Added Mmm to the app directory, a static Arabic RTL web app that implements Pollinations.ai’s BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE login flow entirely client-side.
gist.impact: People can discover Mmm and use its browser-based Pollinations sign-in without the app needing a backend server.
gist.visual_concept: Show Mmm as a cozy browser window with a right-to-left Arabic interface, connected by a small key and a looping login path to a Pollinations sign-in screen. Polli guides the connection; flowers and code-plants make the app-directory setting feel welcoming. No Mmm logo or mascot is identified in the PR.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears tiny reading glasses and gently guides a little pixel key between two browser windows, one showing Mmm’s right-to-left Arabic interface and the other a simple sign-in screen; lime green (#ecf874) code-plants bloom around them against warm cream and pastel gradients. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
